verdict.rationale: PayPal documents an official MCP server that lets merchants run business tasks in natural language from their own MCP clients, and a runtime probe confirms the remote server at mcp.paypal.com is live and OAuth-protected. The agent toolkit exposes orders, refunds, disputes, invoices and catalog management as function-calling tools, and Store Sync lets shoppers buy through conversational interfaces in everyday language. Missing for 10: a native first-party natural-language interface (natural language works only through third-party MCP clients or agent frameworks), and independent hands-on evidence of natural-language commands completing real tasks end to end.
